scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
恭喜。
向战士们致敬！

[武术宗师]
技巧。
速度。
力量。
敏捷。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
A Champion can
benefit from all
these things. But
one can only master
so much in life...
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
这些都能让武术宗师受益。
但人的一生，能精通的东西终究有限...

scripts.text:
[Champion]
It's time.
Time for great heroes
to stand up against the
forces of evil which plague
the world of Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
时机已到。
伟大的英雄们，是时候挺身而出，对抗肆虐米德加尔特的邪恶势力了！

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Would you like
to become a Champion?
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
你愿意成为武术宗师吗？

scripts.text:
[Champion]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Champion]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Congratulations!
Live as a Champion,
and bring light into
the world through the
strength of your fists.
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
恭喜！
以武术宗师的身份，用双拳的力量为世界带来光明吧。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
在这里安心休息吧。
向战士们致敬！
